capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database: 74.0 kWh usable of 77.4 nominal (EU listing 2021-2024; same pack).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: EV Database: 697 V nominal, 800 V architecture.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: 2024 EV6 manual (via ManualsLib) shows a Battery conditioning mode setting in EV Settings plus the DC-charger-as-destination trigger; Kia says the feature is standard from MY23 and was a retrofit for MY22 (src-insideevs-ev6-cold-weather-update, Europe). Compared model years 2022-2024; same first-generation hardware. The manual says it needs a battery heater; not confirmed per Canadian/US trim.

dc_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia: 240 kW for the 77.4 kWh pack (Kia claim). EV Database lists 233 kW.

ac_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs relaying Kia US specs: 10.9 kW onboard charger on both 2022 packs (58 and 77.4 kWh). EV Database 11 kW is the EU figure.

published_10_80_min.notes: EV Database: Kia claims 18 min on a 350 kW charger; EVDB table ~17 min.
